meta.name: pptx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和提取演示文稿内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理 .pptx 或 .potx 格式的演示文稿文件
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and extract content from presentations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with .pptx or .potx presentation files

howto.what: Claude 能创建、读取和编辑 .pptx/.potx 演示文稿:可生成新幻灯片、从已有文件中取出文字、修改版面或内容,也能处理模板、备注与评论,还能拆分或合并幻灯文件。操作通过脚本完成,并做文件校验。
howto.when: 当用户提到「deck」「slides」「presentation」等词,或提到 .pptx/.potx 文件名时触发;凡是需要创建、打开、读取或修改这类演示文件的任务都会用它。

say.text: 帮我做一份12页的产品发布 pptx,图表和备注都要。
say.note: 会新建文件并加入图表与演讲者备注。

say.text: 把模板 test.potx 的标题版式套到我的内容上。
say.note: 会先生成缩略图选版式,再填入内容。

say.text: 从 deck.pptx 里读出每页标题和备注,列成清单。
say.note: 会用工具读取文件并输出文字清单。

howto.what_en: Claude can create, read, and edit .pptx/.potx decks: generate new slides, extract text from existing files, modify layouts or content, handle templates, speaker notes and comments, and merge or split slide files. These operations run through helper scripts and include file validation.
howto.when_en: It activates when the user mentions "deck", "slides", "presentation", or any .pptx/.potx filename, and applies to any task that needs to create, open, read, or modify such presentation files.

say_en.text: Create a 12-page product-launch pptx with charts and notes.
say_en.note: A new file is built and saved.

say_en.text: Apply the title layout from template.potx to my content.
say_en.note: Layouts are previewed, then content is filled in.

say_en.text: List each slide's title and notes from deck.pptx.
say_en.note: The file is read and the text is returned.
